title.narrative: RS! Indonesia - Tea

description.narrative: This project is part of RECLAIM Sustainability! Consortium, which aims to reclaim the essence of sustainability by building an enabling environment for farmers and workers to have equal position with other stakeholders in the supply chain. Reclaim Sustainability! Project in tea sector in Indonesia is to empower farmers and workers, and their association to be independent and have an improved bargaining position within domestic supply chain.
